kind: synthetic: one cell per modern CSS feature (list: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance), to see what the capture and the build translate, lose or get wrong
notes: 01-02 gradients in oklch: stops resampled in that space (web-items resample), sRGB blend kept the browser's curve within 1/255
03 color-mix, relative color, light-dark: computed by the browser, read as sRGB by __angeloSrgb
06 text-box trim: the box is trimmed (28 px) but its line rect keeps the full line height (47 px, starts 11 px above the box)
07 corner-shape squircle: not read by the capture, built as a plain 40 px radius (Figma has cornerSmoothing)
09 accent-color: checkbox and radio read as checked without their color; range and progress lose their track and bar
10 subgrid, 11 container query, 12 anchor positioning, 13 popover: resolved boxes, nothing specific to translate
